name: Ogasawara Islands
story: The Ogasawara Islands are a Japanese archipelago of over 30 subtropical and tropical islands located in Japan. The group as a whole has a total area of 84 square kilometers. Because of their isolation, many of their animals and plants have undergone unique evolutionary processes.
matters: They were named a Natural World Heritage Site in 2011 and are home to endemic species like the Bonin flying fox, which lives in subtropical forests.
